title: Pokkiri Raja
desc: Sanjeev loses his job and his girlfriend leaves him due to his massive yawns. Later, he goes to a doctor to get himself cured and learns that he has inherited a superpower from his great-grandfather.

title: Aaha Enna Porutham
desc: A con man's attempt at a rich life takes an odd turn when he becomes a part of a family feud in the village where he sets up his sham.

title: Thaaya Tharama
desc: A man and a woman fall in love. Later, he approaches her mother and asks for her hand, despite his parents' disapproval.

title: Amma Vanthachu
desc: Nandakumar, a medical representative, meets Nandini, a salesgirl, and both fall in love. Trouble visits their relationship in the form of a young child, who claims to be Nandakumar's daughter.

title: Pandi Nattu Thangam
desc: A village chief and his father, who control the village activities besides smuggling sandalwood, create problems for a forest officer, Thangapandian, and a fellow villager, Radha.
